budget_deviations.impact: no leftovers; 2 owned children (1 native + 1 docker) were the only ones used for evidence

not_deletable_retained.note: Hub keeps execution history after the task definition is deleted (by design); no execution-delete API exists. Their task_ids now point at deleted definitions, which is why they render as 未知任务.
not_deletable_retained.audit_rows: DELETE/audit rows written for the owned objects are append-only history and were not counted individually.
